description: Unique identifier assigned to the source document. Multiple chunks may share the same document ID.
Format or type of the source document, such as TXT, HTML, Markdown, Word, or PDF.
Unique identifier assigned to an individual text chunk extracted from a document.
Number of words contained in the corresponding text chunk.
Relevance or similarity score associated with retrieving the chunk for a query. Higher values indicate a stronger retrieval match.
Category of the user query: factual, analytical, comparative, procedural, or summarization.
Score representing the assessed quality of the answer associated with the query and retrieved content.
